name: Staggered Menu
rationale: Clean-room implementation from the one-line description "Multi-layer menu entrance" only; no upstream source was read and the GSAP timeline is replaced by staggered CSS transitions driven by one open class.

position.description: Edge the layers and panel enter from.

layers.description: Coloured sheets that sweep in before the panel.

layerColors.description: Comma-separated layer colours, cycled when there are more layers than colours.

width.description: Panel width (any CSS length); it never exceeds the container.

duration.description: Slide time of each layer and of the panel, in ms.

stagger.description: Delay between consecutive layers and between links, in ms.

numbered.description: Show a small 01, 02 index after each list link.

closeOnSelect.description: Close the menu when a link inside the panel is activated.

fixed.description: Cover the viewport (position: fixed) instead of the nearest positioned ancestor.

a11y: The toggle is a real <button> whose aria-expanded tracks the open state; it stays above the panel so it doubles as the close control.
Escape closes the menu from anywhere inside the nav and returns focus to the toggle; a click outside also closes it.
The closed panel is visibility: hidden, so its links leave the tab order and the accessibility tree; the coloured layers are aria-hidden divs.
The 01/02 index numbers are CSS generated content with empty alternative text, so link names stay "Work", "Services" and so on.
